items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Lionel Newman was very fond of Benny Carter... he saw so much in Benny Carter

ctx.x: Well, it couldn't have been that you were doing a bad job, or your contract wouldn't have been renewed.

Right. But anyway, I'm just saying, ever since I can remember, the closest anyone came to being on the staff was Lionel Newman was very fond of Benny Carter, you know -- very fond of Benny Carter. And when Benny Carter had his big band down here -- you know, Benny used to do a lot of work at 20th Century Fox, and they wanted him to come off the road with the band and wanted to give him a job there as a composer and arranger.
